meta.name: islambouli-attestation
meta.description: The frozen expectation the Islambouli table's k/40 is judged against: per root of the second holdout, its Quranic uses (gloss + one own verse), written BLIND to the letter table and committed before any reading of these roots existed; then per-use verdicts once the readings exist.
meta.state: MEASURED. Uses frozen blind (5c26985), readings generated after them (c98d522), then every use judged under the inherited criterion; collision computed after the verdicts.
the_ordering_is_the_protocol: A root's `uses[]` is written and committed FIRST, from morphology.json's occurrence list and the aṣl's verbatim, with the concept not yet generated.
The reading is generated afterwards, blind: nothing under linguistics/lisan/islambouli/ but confront.py may read the aṣl or the uses, and an import boundary enforces it.
Only then is each use judged `covered` or `not_covered`, and `reading_recorded_at` stamped.

how_these_uses_were_written.writer: Five fresh sub-agents that never saw the poster, the table or its files, one per batch of the bundle built by `python scripts/record_islambouli_verdicts.py bundle <dir>` (deterministic: the same command reproduces every batch byte for byte; digests below).
how_these_uses_were_written.input: Per root: Ibn Fāris' aṣl verbatim from maqayis_asl.csv and every occurrence verse from morphology.json, vocalized from quran_chakl.csv with the Basmala stripped. The procedure is the template in record_islambouli_verdicts.py (PROMPT_TEMPLATE). No example use was given: an example drawn from the closed run would have passed its writer's manner to the blind one.
how_these_uses_were_written.dispatch_prompt: Read the file <batch file> in full with the Read tool (use offset/limit to page through it until you have read every line). That is the ONLY tool call you may make and the ONLY file you may read: do not search, do not run commands, do not open any other file or directory. Then carry out the instructions written at the top of that file exactly. Your final reply must be ONLY the JSON object those instructions ask for — no preamble, no commentary, no code fence.
how_these_uses_were_written.why_a_file_and_not_inline: The 41 roots carry about 644 000 characters of verse text, which does not fit one prompt, so the bundle is split into 5 batches under one template. Pasting them inline would have cost that much output again for identical content, so each agent was given the path of its own batch file.
how_these_uses_were_written.restriction: By instruction, not enforced by the harness. AUDITED AFTERWARDS: each agent's transcript shows exactly one kind of tool call — Read of its own batch file — and its final handback.
how_these_uses_were_written.raw_outputs: Each agent's final JSON was extracted mechanically from its transcript, not retyped, and recorded here unchanged. The only check applied is that each verse belongs to its root's occurrences: 0 failures.

how_these_uses_were_written.development_case: ضرب was in batch 4, written by the same template in the same pass as 11 witness roots. Its blind uses are `uses_blind`; `uses` holds the closed run's five, unchanged.

granularity_observed.note: The blind writer produced about twice as many uses per root as the closed run's curator (379 against 183). Under a metric where a root counts only when EVERY use is covered, a finer list is harder to cover. This is the difference in NATURE that R5 warned of, measured — it bears on how the two numbers compare, and it is reported with them, not corrected.

coverage_criterion.rule: A use is `covered` when a reader given ONLY the realised row texts, in their positional order, and told nothing about the root, would recognise that use's notion as something the reading says.
coverage_criterion.rule_as_inherited: A use is `covered` when a reader given ONLY the realised primitives, in their positional order, and told nothing about the root, would recognise that use's notion as something the reading says.
tests_all_necessary: nothing imported — every content notion of the gloss traces to at least one realised primitive; if the step from primitives to gloss needs a notion the nine do not carry, it is not covered

not merely inert — the primitives must do more than fail to contradict the gloss; at least one realised primitive must carry the gloss's CENTRAL notion. Nine notions are compatible with almost anything, so «does not contradict» is the failure mode this reading is most prone to
the direction holds — opens → body → concludes is part of the claim; a gloss needing the root to end in an opening-out is not covered by a reading whose third position is قَطْع
coverage_criterion.the_prohibition: The judge may not use what they know the root means to build the bridge. Knowing that قوم is standing makes «أَصْل · ظُهور» look like a foundation; it looks like one only to someone who already has the answer. Where the bridge needs the root's meaning, the verdict is not_covered.

miss_classes.imported: the gloss needs a notion absent from the realised primitives
miss_classes.inert: the primitives are compatible with the gloss and say nothing about it
miss_classes.direction: the positional order contradicts the gloss
miss_classes.collision: another root with a divergent aṣl composes to these exact realised primitives, so nothing in this reading is about this root

applications_fixed_before_any_reading: «أو» is disjunctive: a position says a notion when either alternative of its row's gloss says it.
The whole text of a row counts as said — qualifiers («في الزمان والمكان», «في الشيء») and row 0's clause included.
The unit changed from primitives to glosses: where the inherited wording says «primitive», read «the row text realised at that position».
coverage_criterion.collision_is_computed_afterwards: Whether another QAC root composes to the same realised primitives is a mechanical fact about the table, not a judgement. It is recorded per root as `collision_with` and derived AFTER the judging pass, so that knowing a root collides cannot soften or harden the reading of its uses. The criterion above never mentions collision: a use fails on the three tests before anyone asks why.

meta.no_partial_credit: A use is `covered` or it is not, and a root counts toward k only when EVERY one of its uses is covered. There is no weighting, no «mostly», and no grade between the two. A root with no `uses[]` on file is `not_recorded` — never `covers_all`: an empty list must never read as full coverage.
meta.a_miss_is_a_result: A root whose reading fails to cover an attested use is recorded as a miss with one line of reason, and that record is NEVER a reason to change a row of the table: the table is transcribed, and a changed row would no longer cite Islambouli.
meta.audit: Audit is POSSIBLE, not performed. There is no second judge: the curator writes the verdicts. What is committed here — the frozen uses, the verdict and its reason, beside the generated reading and its lock version — is everything a reader who clones the repository needs to redo the judgement and disagree. No claim of independent review is made anywhere.
